thread:
Leah Park: opened PR 2087 to add a new docs section: 'usage-exporter CLI' and an example that shows how to pull quota headers and export daily consumption CSVs for the cost calculator. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2087. This is intended for ops teams who want quick on-prem tooling.
Ibrahim Khan: neat. does the CLI rely on X-Quota-* headers or does it read from the usage API? curious because some Dedicated/private installs don't surface headers.
Leah Park: it prefers headers when available for realtime checks, falls back to /v1/usage aggregated endpoint when headers missing. added a short design note in the PR explaining the fallback ordering.
Clara Zhou: can you include a tiny example of the CSV output format in the docs and a JS snippet that parses headers defensively? support wants copy-paste examples.
Leah Park: added sample CSV preview and this snippet: 
```js
// minimal parsing example
const q = resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining');
const quotaLeft = q ? parseInt(q, 10) : null; // null = unknown
if (quotaLeft === null) console.log('quota unknown, using aggregated usage API');
```
Ibrahim Khan: product question: after the billing unit change for embeddings (now per 1k tokens), should the CLI convert tokens to billing units before exporting cost columns?
Product Notifications: Product: Confirmed guidance: billing values should use the current meter unit. For embeddings use per-1k tokens. We recommend exporting both raw token counts and billing units to avoid confusion.
Leah Park: updated CSV columns to include tokens, billing_units, unit_cost, total_cost. Also added a short paragraph about meter-unit conversions and a worked example using embeddings.
Clara Zhou: Docs CI flagged one broken anchor to /docs/observability/usage-dashboard#daily-summary. the dashboard anchor was renamed. please update links.
Leah Park: fixed the anchor to /docs/observability/usage-dashboard#daily-summary-panel and re-uploaded a smaller screenshot to docs/assets/observability/usage-exporter-preview.png. pushed.
Docs CI: Linkcheck retest: all links OK, image size within guidelines.
Ibrahim Khan: editorial: avoid language "assume unlimited" in the CLI docs. prefer "treat as unknown and consult dashboard or aggregated usage endpoint".
Leah Park: switched wording accordingly and added a short FAQ row: "When headers are absent, the CLI uses the aggregated usage endpoint; quota columns will be empty/marked unknown."
Clara Zhou: small addition: include a note that Dedicated returns headers only when routed through our metering proxy; Private/on-prem behavior varies. product copied text into PR?
Product Notifications: Product: Pasting final line: "Quota headers (X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset) are emitted by Redwood's metering proxy. Hosted (metered) -> yes. Dedicated -> only when routed through metering proxy; Private/on-prem -> depends on customer setup."
Leah Park: added product blurb to the FAQ, updated changelog at docs/changelog/2026-04-02.md, and left follow-ups: add Python & Go CLI examples next sprint, and open an org-wide PR to harmonize dashboard anchors. merging when CI green.
Docs CI: All checks passed on retest \u2014 docs tests green.
Leah Park: merged. closing thread; will add a short support note with the CSV format and fallback behavior. :white_check_mark:
